items.title: Turing reports AI model that identifies individual satellite components
items.summary_en: The Turing's news page lists an item dated 9 October 2026 about an AI model that can identify individual components on a satellite. It is framed as helping the UK safeguard key satellites. Only the teaser was visible to the collector, so technical details and the specific project are unconfirmed.
items.notes: From a search-result summary of the Turing pages; fetch of turing.ac.uk failed. Article URL not identified. Do not assume a link to other Turing space-security work.

items.title: Turing welcomes 71 PhD students to its Enrichment scheme
items.summary_en: The Turing says 71 PhD students have joined its Enrichment scheme. They come from 27 academic institutions across the UK. This is an institutional/community announcement, not a research result.

items.title: Turing appoints three new members to its Board of Trustees
items.summary_en: The Turing announced on 5 October 2026 that Tracey Bowen-Lowe, Catherine Graham and Rakshit Kapoor have joined its Board of Trustees. This is a governance update with no research content.
